The '''Alliance SpecForce Officers Training Manual''' was a document maintained by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Used to train their [[Officer/Legends|officers]], it detailed the operational principles that SpecForce was to operate under.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
